sources.quote: 1 retroTECH Item(s) ; 2.5 x 10 x 6.75 inches (height x width x depth)

sources.method: 25.4 mm per inch x the inch figures of sources[0] (Georgia Tech retroTECH record, labelled height x width x depth): width 10 in = 254, height 2.5 in = 63.5, depth 6.75 in = 171.45 mm; exact products, no rounding.

sources.quote: The Component includes two Hand Controllers which are connected with coil cables. They are detachable just by gently pulling out these
The INTELLIVISION® II Master Component should bring you many years of video game entertainment

notes: Envelope: Georgia Tech Archives, Digital Media Lab retroTECH Collection (RT00033), item 'Mattel Intellivision II console, 1982', model number 5872, serial P20047695 (museum tier, labelled axes, inches only, hence the derived source).

Quotes from an archive.org scan of the maker's own printed manual are taken from the scan's OCR text layer (the item's _djvu.txt), byte for byte; where a quoted sentence wraps in the scan, the two OCR lines are joined with one space. The archive.org scan of the maker's document counts as primary. Manual: Intellivision II Master Component Owner's Manual, model 5872, '© Mattel, Inc. 1982', 5872-0920 (archive.org item intellivision-ii-master-component-owners-manual-1982).

Partial facts not filed: one 'RESET ON/OFF button' with a red indicator light (a combined control with no single §3 kind), a Channel Selector Switch at the right rear, the connector cable 'at left rear of Component', the transformer's 'power cord in socket at rear of console'; 'Insert cartridge in slot on right side of Component' (side slot: no §3 media kind).
released: Georgia Tech gives 'Creation: 1982' and a narrative 'In the spring of 1983, Mattel introduced the Intellivision II'; neither is a maker date, null.

external_ids: Wikidata has no separate Intellivision II item (search returns Q1061441, the platform), so wikidata null; igdb_platform 'intellivision' is Q1061441's P5795, the platform this model plays.
